_note: Progression model. Enforces §7/§8: level is a SHALLOW foundation so it never drowns the resonance skill axis. Damage uses only levelPower (potency), NOT a big ATK stat. Support potency (heal amount, guard duration) scales a little. XP is distributed to the STORY-LEGAL roster only (AGENTS 1). Stored in SavedCharacterStats which already has level/xp fields -> no save migration.

xpCurve.overflow: carry leftover xp into next level; multiple level-ups per battle allowed

xpDistribution.share: even split among all ALIVE story-legal members; fallen members receive 50% share (still gain)

bossLumpBonus.note: bosses grant their own baseXp (see enemies.json, 500-2000), plus a small clear bonus scaled to chapter

xpDistribution.noOverLevel: cap effective level to chapterSoftCap so late-chapter mobs feel meaningful (optional; default off)

statGrowthPerLevel._: additive per level-up; potencyMultiplier feeds (spell.basePower + levelPower) and support scaling

levelPowerFormula: levelPower = round(basePower * potencyPct * (level-1))  -- capped at +90% at level 30

spellUnlocks._default: all base kit spells unlocked at level 1; tier-6 ultimates unlock at level 6; a class tier-11 spell slot may be added in Phase 5

restNodeBehavior: camp/rest still restores HP/MP to max (StoryViewModel.kt:351); level-ups persist through it. Attrition of HP/MP between rests remains the pacing lever.
